newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower in all maturities following the sharp drop in Treasury bill rates, traders said on Tuesday.
PHIBOR also dropped after the Central Bank on Tuesday lowered its rates on special series T-bills.
On Monday, the bellwether 91-day Treasury bill rate fell to 10.746 percent from 11.172 percent. This marked the second time rates fell after a cut in reserve requirements on January 3.
One dealer said rates whould level off next week as excess liquidity is siphoned off by the Central Bank's special series T-bills and term reverse repos.
